Section B: Education

text: Sociologists debate whether families are functional or dysfunctional. Many types of family exist,
such as extended and symmetrical families. Family life and roles can be affected by factors such
as ethnicity, gender, age and social class.

Section C: Crime, deviance and social control

text: There are many different types of schools. For example, comprehensive schools and private schools.
However, all schools educate, socialise and socially control students. Sociologists investigate
different social groups’ experiences of education. This includes investigating factors such as cultural
capital and the culture of masculinity.

text: There are many perspectives on the media, such as Marxist and feminist views. The media
represents social groups, such as ethnic minorities and youth, in different ways. The media has
different roles, for example advertising and entertainment. Patterns of consumption can be influenced
by the various forms of media.
